correctness.rationale: PASS: The cubic X1 X2 X3=X0^3 contains no projective line meeting dense torus, since a line on the affine unit torus would have three affine-linear polynomials multiplying to 1 and hence all constant. For chord from identity to B, cubic restriction factors t(t-1)(s3 t-s1). Exactly 3(q-2) B have s3=0, and q-2-rho satisfy each tangency exclusion s1=0 or s1=s3; inversion exchanges the disjoint sets, so each identity torus point has tau=(q-2)(q-5)+2rho partners in triples. Transitive torus action gives n3=N tau/6; projective pair and line incidence gives n2,n1,n0, with degree bound j<=3. For q=3 and 5 tau=0, for q=4 or >=7 tau>0. A 2-dimensional annihilator subcode corresponds bijectively to one ambient projective line, so second Hamming weight is N-max j; d3=N-1,d4=N. Independent exact prime-field pair-line enumeration q=3,5,7 reproduced n2=6,120,378 and n3=0,0,84.
